_comment: Tier-2 for sparta universal:10 and universal:11, executed on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial). universal:10 — 'dump im all image 50 ...' (group before style, the order compute and fix use) gives 'ERROR: Unrecognized dump style (../output.cpp:538)' and the message quotes NO style name, which is why it misleads; 'dump im image all 50 ...' runs and writes PPM files. A '*' in the filename produces one file per snapshot, its absence one file for all of them, checked by listing the working directory. A per-grid compute in a dump obeys the bracket rule ('ERROR: Dump grid compute does not calculate per-grid vector (../dump_grid.cpp:515)' without it, clean with it). 'dump movie' PARSES and then fails at the first dump step with 'ERROR on proc 0: Support for writing movies not included (../dump_movie.cpp:52)' — a registered style this build cannot run. universal:11 — 'fix halt 20 v_n < ...' with the default 'error soft' ends the run before the step count 'run' asked for AND exits 0, which is asserted as the exit status plus the last Step of the table against the run argument, no number stored; 'error hard' makes the identical condition a nonzero exit; a bare stats keyword gives 'ERROR: Invalid fix halt attribute np (../fix_halt.cpp:62)'. 'fix print' with an undefined ${x} does NOT stop the deck at parse time: the 'Step Np' header appears in the log BEFORE 'Substitution for illegal variable', which is asserted as the ORDER of two lines in one log, and a variable defined AFTER the fix print line still works. COVERS: universal:10, universal:11. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): 'error hard' is appended to the soft-halt deck — the single keyword that turns a silent early stop into a nonzero exit — and the missing print variable is defined before the fix. Box, grid, seed, condition, stats interval and run length are untouched. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: a_soft_halt_exits_zero=True, an_undefined_variable_survives_setup=True. The dump assertions run on decks the hook does not touch and rest on verbatim messages carrying their own (file:line) plus a directory listing. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/dump_order_halt_and_deferred_print && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line, which forbid_in_output turns into a failure.
